source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026; historical basionyms and ranks verified against the listed POWO name records
name_concept_summary: Rye is an accepted species, but historical S. cereale subsp. segetale, dighoricum and afghanicum map to accepted S. segetale; subsp./var. vavilovii map to accepted S. vavilovii. Named wheat × rye hybrid × Triticosecale rimpaui is separate. No specimens or photos reidentified.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; county nativity untouched
specimen_identity: HOLD — individual photo/voucher identity not independently verified
hybrid_provenance: HOLD — named artificial hybrid formula does not establish an individual specimen's pedigree
install_decision: Retain installed rye card unchanged; no new cards or alias injection; taxonomy evidence only

decisions.subject: Secale cereale L. (1753)
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted species and Linnaean authorship; no canonical rename.
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP 2026 accepts rye; the installed species card omits the authority but taxonomy-only worker does not edit it.

decisions.subject: Triticum cereale (L.) Salisb. (1796)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record homotypic historical combination under Secale cereale L.
decisions.detail: Do not create Triticum learner duplicate.

decisions.subject: Triticum secale Link (1833)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record illegitimate superfluous historical name under Secale cereale L.
decisions.detail: Not a separately accepted wheat or rye species.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale var. vulgare Ser. (1841)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as not validly published; not an accepted variety.
decisions.detail: Retain nomenclatural status.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale var. hybernum Aiton (1789)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Secale cereale L.
decisions.detail: No separately accepted subspecies inferred.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale subsp. ancestrale Zhuk. (1928)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies to Secale cereale L.
decisions.detail: POWO lists this under the accepted species.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale var. ancestrale (Zhuk.) Kit Tan (1985)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to Secale cereale L.
decisions.detail: Distinct from segetale and vavilovii mappings.

decisions.subject: Secale segetale (Zhuk.) Roshev. (1945)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as a separately accepted species, not a rye subspecies.
decisions.detail: No installation or new learner card.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale subsp. segetale Zhuk. (1928)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies to accepted Secale segetale.
decisions.detail: Cross-species accepted destination.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale subsp. dighoricum Vavilov (1940)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies to accepted Secale segetale.
decisions.detail: Cross-species accepted destination.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale subsp. afghanicum (Vavilov) K.Hammer (1987)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies to accepted Secale segetale.
decisions.detail: Do not treat as rye.

decisions.subject: Secale vavilovii Grossh. (1924)
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as separately accepted species.
decisions.detail: Not an accepted subspecies of S. cereale.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale subsp. vavilovii (Grossh.) Kobyl. (1975)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical subspecies to accepted Secale vavilovii.
decisions.detail: Cross-species accepted destination.

decisions.subject: Secale cereale var. vavilovii (Grossh.) Mayss. (1925)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical variety to accepted Secale vavilovii.
decisions.detail: Cross-species accepted destination.

decisions.subject: × Triticosecale rimpaui (M.Graebn.) Wittm. ex A.W.Hill (1933)
decisions.proposed_decision: Record separately accepted artificial hybrid, formula Secale cereale × Triticum aestivum subsp. aestivum.
decisions.detail: Taxonomy-only parentage; not proof for any individual photo.

decisions.subject: × Triticale rimpaui (M.Graebn.) Lindschau & E.Oehler (1935)
decisions.proposed_decision: Map historical homotypic name to × Triticosecale rimpaui.
decisions.detail: Do not create a rye species alias from the hybrid.

decisions.subject: Bulk-map all historical Secale cereale subspecies to Secale cereale
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; segetale, dighoricum, afghanicum and vavilovii combinations map to distinct accepted Secale species.
decisions.detail: Preserve original rank and authorship.

decisions.subject: Collapse Secale cereale, Secale segetale and Secale vavilovii into one learner species
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; three separately accepted species under POWO/WCVP.
decisions.detail: No new card and no changes to existing canonical.

decisions.subject: Treat × Triticosecale rimpaui as ordinary rye or infer it from a rye field photograph
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject; named intergeneric artificial hybrid requires parentage evidence.
decisions.detail: No hybrid identification based on shared cereal appearance.

decisions.subject: Existing Secale cereale photographs and specimen-level identifications
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve source-label identity only; no voucher-level rye/wild-rye/hybrid reassignment.
decisions.detail: Taxonomy-only check cannot authenticate individual photographed plants.

decisions.subject: Individual cultivar, wild ancestry or wheat × rye hybrid provenance
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not assign specific parentage or cultivated pedigree without accession, voucher or genetic evidence.
decisions.detail: Accepted named hybrid formula does not validate a field specimen.

decisions.subject: Historical Secale cereale infraspecific records lacking author/rank/voucher
decisions.proposed_decision: Leave unresolved pending exact original combination and specimen context.
decisions.detail: Shared historical parent binomial alone cannot establish accepted species destination.
